faq.question: What is CouponSite?
faq.answer: CouponSite (formerly 优惠总动员 / Coupon Hub) is a real-time promo code and discount aggregator covering 20+ major brands including Nike, Adidas, ASOS, Amazon, Sephora, Steam, and Booking.com across fashion, electronics, travel, beauty, and pet supplies. All links are affiliate links; the service is free for shoppers.

faq.question: Are the coupon codes free to use?
faq.answer: Yes. All coupon codes on CouponSite are free to view and use. No signup or payment required.

faq.question: How do I use a coupon code?
faq.answer: Three steps: 1) Find the coupon you want on the homepage or merchant page; 2) Click the Copy Code button; 3) Paste the code into the promo code box at checkout on the merchant's website to apply the discount.

faq.question: Do coupon codes expire?
faq.answer: Yes. Each coupon code has an expiry date. We mark expired codes as Expired and remove them from the homepage. Always check the expiry label on the coupon card before checking out.

faq.question: How do I verify a coupon code is still valid?
faq.answer: Every active coupon code displays a green Verified badge, indicating it has been verified by automated or manual checks recently. Codes labeled Exclusive are unique partnerships with the merchant.

faq.question: Does the site support English?
faq.answer: Yes. Click the EN / 中文 toggle in the top-right corner of the page to switch languages. Merchant pages and coupon details are fully bilingual.

faq.question: What is an affiliate link?
faq.answer: An affiliate link is a tracked promotion link. When you click through from CouponSite and complete a purchase, the merchant pays us a small commission at no extra cost to you. You pay exactly the same price as visiting the merchant directly.

faq.question: How do I use the discount calculator?
faq.answer: Open the Discount Calculator from the top navigation. Enter the original price and discount percentage, and the calculator instantly returns the final price and the amount saved. Stacked discounts are supported.

faq.question: How can I get updates on new coupons?
faq.answer: Subscribe to our RSS feed (/rss.xml) for automatic updates when new coupons are published. You can also visit the blog (/blog) for regularly curated money-saving guides.

faq.question: How do I contact CouponSite?
faq.answer: Visit the /about page for contact details, or send an email to the listed contact address. We typically reply within 1 to 2 business days.
